 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lagitimate"** is a misspelling of the correct word "Legitimate." It means something that is lawful, rightful, or in accordance with accepted standards. (वैध)

 
 
• **Example: **His claim to the property is **legitimate **according to the will.
 
 
 
• **"Legitimate" **refers to something that is conforming to the law or to rules; it is considered legal and valid. (वैध)
 
 
• **Example: **The company operates within the bounds of **legitimate** business practices.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lexicon **(शब्दकोश): The vocabulary of a person, language, or branch of knowledge.

 
 
• **Example:** The** lexicon** of legal terms can be quite complex.
 
 
 
• **Logarithm **(लघुगणक): A mathematical function that helps in calculating exponential growth or decay.
 
 
• **Example: Logarithms** are used to solve equations involving exponential functions.
 
 
 
• **Library** (पुस्तकालय): A place where books, manuscripts, and other materials are kept for reading and reference.
 
 
• **Example:** The university **library** has an extensive collection of historical documents.
